reason: Bile is shown spreading fat into smaller droplets, directly matching one goal.
expectation: I expect smaller fat droplets, with the fat molecules still unchanged.

alternatives.reason: Protein and digestive enzymes also match a goal, but I want to see the fat droplets first.

effect: The droplets expose more surface, and the new goal is to break down the fat molecules.
reaction: The difference between spreading fat and breaking its molecules is clearer now.
reason: Digestive enzymes match the new fat-breakdown goal, and the smaller droplets expose more surface.
expectation: I expect the enzymes to break the fat molecules into smaller molecules, though I don't know exactly what they will be.

alternatives.reason: Protein also needs breaking down, but I want to follow the fat process first.

effect: Fat digestion is complete; bile spread the droplets and enzymes split the fat molecules.
reaction: Seeing the two different jobs made the sequence clearer.
reason: Saliva is shown acting on starch, so I want to follow what happens to starchy food.
expectation: I expect saliva to start breaking down the starch, though I don't know whether it finishes the job.

alternatives.reason: Protein also needs breaking down, but I want to explore starch first.

effect: Saliva shortened the starch chains, but they still need further breakdown.
reaction: That makes saliva's starting role clearer.
reason: Digestive enzymes can continue breaking down the shorter chains toward the starch goal.
expectation: I expect smaller sugar molecules, possibly individual glucose units.

alternatives.reason: Protein also needs digestion, but I want to finish following starch first.

effect: The enzymes finished breaking the starch into glucose, which can cross the intestinal lining.
reaction: It is clear how the long chain became separate glucose units.
reason: Protein still needs breaking down, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the enzymes to break the protein into smaller pieces, possibly amino acids.

effect: Protein was broken into separate amino acids, completing the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: The protein chain becoming its building blocks was straightforward.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat from large droplets to smaller droplets and then broken molecules was most worthwhile. It made bile's job different from the enzymes' job.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final protein combination was the only offered action and felt predictable, although its result was clear.

surprise.text: I didn't initially know whether saliva would finish digesting starch; it produced shorter chains that needed another step.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals connected each pairing to digestion. Still, the compatible options guided the choices rather than requiring me to discover them.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the small food molecules cross the gut lining and reach cells. The starch and fat sequences made that next connection interesting.
